items.note: Compares GPT-3 Alternative Uses Test responses with previously collected human responses on expert-rated originality, usefulness, surprise, flexibility, and semantic distance; no participant used AI (abstract from the arXiv landing page; ICCC 2022 version has no DOI).

Benchmarks several LLMs against individual humans and groups of humans on 13 creative tasks in three domains (divergent thinking, problem solving, creative writing); no participant used AI and the abstract gives no human sample size.

Meme-creation user study with three groups of 50 (human-only, human-AI collaboration with an LLM, AI-only), with crowd ratings of creativity, humor, and shareability; the abstract says 150 participants in three groups but the AI-only group generated memes autonomously, so 100 people produced memes, and assignment to groups is not stated.

Compares GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4, and GPT-4o with humans on divergent and convergent thinking, insight, creative writing, association, and creative evaluation and selection tasks; no participant used AI and the abstract gives no human sample size.

Randomized online experiment in which people generate new product ideas with ChatGPT versus Google Search, with idea count, novelty, diversity, and functional appropriateness as outcomes; abstract from Crossref (not in OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar), and it gives no sample size.
